name: FTSE 100
summary: FTSE 100 about 1.4% below its high; energy and mining weighting cushions it
state: The FTSE 100 closed near 10,761 on 2 Nov, about 1.4% below its 52-week high and up 2.5% over the month. Its heavy weighting to oil, gas and mining firms has cushioned it from the energy shock and the 30 Oct sell-off in US technology shares. The Bank of England decides on rates on 5 Nov.
for_you: UK shares are near record levels. Pension funds with UK equity exposure have not seen a market fall of note.
rubric_hit: FTSE drawdown 1.4% < 5% Watch line; no daily fall > 2.5%
why: The UK's main index — a gauge of UK-listed multinationals, pensions and sterling-area sentiment.
drivers: Commodity prices, sterling, global risk appetite, UK policy and banking sector news.
